lines: Likely is seeing fewer looks lately: 6.7 targets per game over his last 3, down from 8.3 on the season, with a 21% target share.
He played 80% of snaps over his last 3 games and has 7 total TDs this season, averaging 16.2 PPR points over that stretch.
Harbaugh said his missed Friday practice is minor and he'll be fine. IND allows the 14th-most PPR points per game to tight ends.
